plugins.label: Aliases Plus
plugins.description: Modified aliases.py to list player aliases without lagging the server.

plugins.label: Auto Kick
plugins.description: This plugin will automatically kick users (after 1 warning) for using words added to the word list.

plugins.description: Shows a list of the last 5 played maps. Useful to avoid voting overplayed maps.

plugins.description: Manages map rotation, enforces vote cooldowns on recently played maps, and tracks off-pool callvotes too. Also replaces/includes features of lastmaps.py
